versions.changelog:
tarot-reader 1.0.0

- Initial release of professional tarot reading skill.
- Provides single card and three-card ("past-present-future") spreads using the classic Rider-Waite Tarot system.
- Supports warm and rational style in all readings, with random upright/reversed draws.
- Activates on keywords like “塔罗”, “抽牌”, “占卜”, and gently prompts users to state their question.
- Delivers structured, context-linked interpretations and follows up for user feedback.
